name: Vipper-MD
description: Multi-number WhatsApp bot built on Baileys. Link as many numbers as you like from one pairing page.

PAIR_KEY.description: Key shown on the pairing page and needed to link a number.

ADMIN_KEY.description: Key for the /admin dashboard that shows linked numbers and users. A random one is generated for you; keep it private.

SUPABASE_URL.description: Your Supabase project URL. Needed so linked numbers and settings survive restarts.

MAX_SESSIONS.description: Most WhatsApp numbers that can be linked at the same time.

SEND_PER_MINUTE.description: Most messages one number may send per minute. The bot waits when this is reached.

SEND_PER_HOUR.description: Most messages one number may send per hour. The bot refuses further sends until the hour passes.

SEND_PER_DAY.description: Most messages one number may send per day. Lower is safer for new numbers.

TIMEZONE.description: Time zone used in the menu, for example Africa/Nairobi or UTC.

CHANNEL_INVITE.description: Invite code at the end of your WhatsApp channel link. Every linked number follows this channel and the menu shows a View channel button.
